5.purpose: The new Thales walks toward a static camera on a sandy riverbank at dusk between a frozen Lydian (left: crested helmet, crimson tunic, bronze scales, lion shield) and a frozen Mede (right: red cap, black beard, ochre tunic, wicker shield), face up the whole time; small frozen fighters against the river; clear steps, full figure throughout.
5.costume: New sheet: short curly dark hair (the fillet is faint at this size), trimmed beard, saffron himation with a dark border over a cream chiton, sandals, wooden tablet in the left hand, short stick in the right. Lydian and Mede per sheets; the Mede's sword on his right.
5.identity: Three distinct men; Thales reads as a Greek philosopher, not a saint.
5.artefacts: None; camera truly static (~2 px drift). Ends full-figure, not in the medium shot asked for.
5.notes: Alternate: the cleanest separation of the three figures, but Thales is small in S52's 0-2.11 s window.

6.purpose: S52 with the new Thales: on a riverbank path at dusk he walks toward the lens between a frozen Lydian mid-thrust on the left (crested helmet, crimson tunic, bronze scales, black lion on a crimson shield) and a frozen Mede on the right (red cap, black beard, ochre tunic, iron scales, wicker shield), frozen fighters along the water behind; face tilted up with amused curiosity, shadow-stick in his right hand, tablet in his left; he ends in a medium shot.
6.costume: Matches the new sheet: short curly dark hair with the thin fillet visible, trimmed curly beard, saffron himation with a dark woven border over a cream chiton, wooden tablet and a short stick (no staff, no red robe, no long hair). Lydian and Mede per sheets; the Mede's sword on his right side.
6.identity: Three distinct men; Thales reads as an Ionian philosopher of the herm type, not as Jesus.
6.artefacts: Very slight camera drift (~8 px at 1280 over 4 s); from ~3.0 s his tablet overlaps the Mede's shield, so the matte joins them (after S52's 0-2.11 s window).
6.notes: 1:1 from t0. S52 uses plate 0-2.11, where Thales (x ~0.50-0.52) is clear of both warriors: the matte component nearest x 0.5 is him. No staff any more: a short gnomon and the tablet.

chosen_why: The new Thales reads clearly in S52's window: a larger figure, fillet and border visible, frozen statues framing him, ending in the medium shot asked for; take 5 is static and clean but Thales is small.
